theme: An open calendar, Croatia four days out.
greeting: No meetings today, Dan, and the girls are with you in St. Pete — a genuinely open Friday. It lands well, because the Croatia countdown is down to four days and a handful of bookings are still on the board.

needsAttention.title: Confirm the checked bags are actually on your ticket
needsAttention.detail: The issued ticket shows zero checked bags on the Eurowings Discover legs. Pull the booking up on the operating carrier's site, and buy bags now if they aren't included — European counter fees run well above the online price, and two 55L duffels won't pass as carry-on. Overdue since Aug 25.

needsAttention.title: Lock the Sept 19 Cavtat night and the marina transfer
needsAttention.detail: The last night before the Sept 20 flight home has to be booked from dry land — charter connectivity dies once you sail on the 8th. That's the Cavtat hotel, the noon transfer from ACI Komolac, and the ~5 AM airport run. Overdue since Aug 26.

needsAttention.title: Fill the Sept 20–22 St Pete landing gap
needsAttention.detail: You land TPA Sunday the 20th but the girls aren't picked up until Tuesday the 22nd — two nights near St Pete are still unbooked ahead of the Orlando villa. Overdue since Aug 25.

flagged.title: Mastercard government-affairs lead wants to connect
flagged.detail: A LinkedIn invitation from Prashanth, VP of Government Engagement & Chief of Staff at Mastercard, is waiting on your response.

flagged.title: A caregiver applied on Care.com
flagged.detail: Gabriella R. applied to the job you posted.

flagged.detail: Your Apple Creator Studio monthly ($12.99) is flagged as expiring soon — renew or let it lapse.

inbox.noise: The rest is newsletters and Labor Day sales — Italian Word of the Day, a language app or two, a home-insurance pitch, and the Todoist digest.

resolved.title: The PRI stewardship call with Conor Kehoe is off
resolved.detail: Conor Kehoe cancelled the 10 AM EDT Zoom on PRI sustainability and stewardship — it's off your calendar, no action needed.

recipe.title: Roasted kabocha squash
recipe.why: The first true week of autumn is squash weather — kabocha's dense sweetness caramelizes beautifully in a hot oven and rewards patience more than fuss.

tasks.title: Book Orlando + Disney tickets — 6 of you, Sept 26–27
Hold a refundable backup SUV for Sept 20 (decide by Sept 7)
Build and pack the travel larder bin
Call the dermatologist to book wart removal
Buy EU plug adapters + a US power strip

acts.line: Nothing on the calendar — a rare, fully open stretch to spend on what's been waiting.
The day stays clear straight through; no meeting bookends it.
The girls are home with you in St. Pete — an easy evening in.
